appearance_facts.fact: Two series span 2012-2020: a solid blue line with circular markers (left axis) and a dashed red line with square markers (right axis). At the 2013 x-position, the red square marker is visibly higher on the page than the blue circular marker.

The 2013 blue marker sits lower than the 2014 blue marker (1257.35) and higher than the 2012 blue marker; the 2013 red marker sits lower than the 2012 red marker and higher than the 2014 red marker (434.33). No numeric label is printed at the 2013 points.

printed_facts.fact: Left y-axis label 'United States' (blue); right y-axis label 'Canada' (red); x-axis label 'Characteristic' with ticks 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020. No numeric tick values are printed on either y-axis.
Printed annotations: blue 1257.35 (2014), 1911.76 (2017); red 434.33 (2014), 491.78 (2017). No 2013 value is printed.

public_definitions: Task: compare 2013 application volume for United States and Canada, then open the follow-up record for the country with the larger 2013 volume.
Options: 'Open 2013 United States grant intake follow-up record', 'Open 2013 Canada grant intake follow-up record', 'Send 2013 grant application comparison to routine archive'.
uncertain: The two series use separate y-axes with no printed scale values, so the 2013 numeric volumes for each country cannot be read or compared from the chart; only relative page height (red marker above blue marker at 2013) is observable.
Because the underlying 2013 values are not printed and the dual axes are unscaled, it is not possible to determine which country has the larger 2013 volume.
